Best Western Hotels & Resorts.description: Best Western Hotels & Resorts is an American hotel company founded in 1946 and based in Phoenix, Arizona, whose hotels operate under brands including Best Western, Best Western Plus, Best Western Premier and BW Signature Collection. In Morocco it is present under the Best Western Plus brand.

Decameron Hotels & Resorts.description: Decameron Hotels & Resorts is an all-inclusive resort company founded in 1987 in Cartagena, Colombia, with resorts in Latin America and the Caribbean. In Morocco it operates the Decameron Tafoukt Beach in Agadir.

Hotusa (Eurostars Hotel Company).description: Eurostars Hotel Company is the hotel division of Grupo Hotusa, a Spanish hospitality group from Barcelona, which created the Eurostars Hotels brand in 2005. Its brands include Eurostars Hotels, Exe Hotels and Ikonik Hotels; in Morocco it operates the Eurostars Casa Anfa in Casablanca.

Idou Hotels.description: Idou Hotels is a Moroccan family hotel group founded by M'hamed Idoulahiane, an entrepreneur from the Tiznit region. Its hotels include the Idou Anfa in Casablanca, opened in 1984, the Idou Tiznit, opened in 2001, and the Idou Malabata Beach & Spa in Tangier.

Meliá Hotels International.description: Meliá Hotels International, formerly Sol Meliá, is a Spanish hotel company founded in Palma de Mallorca in 1956 by Gabriel Escarrer Juliá. Its brands include Gran Meliá, ME by Meliá, Paradisus, Meliá, INNSiDE and Sol; in Morocco it operates the Sol Oasis Marrakech.

Soho Boutique Hotels.description: Soho Boutique Hotels is a Spanish boutique hotel chain founded in Málaga in 2014, with hotels in cities across Spain. In Morocco it has hotels in Casablanca and Tétouan.

The Ascott Limited.description: The Ascott Limited is a Singapore-based lodging company, the wholly owned lodging business of CapitaLand Investment. Its brands include Ascott, Citadines, lyf, Oakwood and Somerset; in Morocco it operates the Citadines Almaz Casablanca.

Xaluca Hotels.description: Grup Xaluca is a family business offering hotels, desert camps, events and services in the south of Morocco, with more than 30 years in hospitality. Its hotels and camps are around Erfoud, at Erg Chebbi near Merzouga, in the Dades valley and in the Middle Atlas.
